extracted.intended_audience: patent practitioners (agents/attorneys) and counsel, parties interested in USPTO reinstatement decisions, Office of Enrollment and Discipline stakeholders
extracted.subtask_description: Administrative decision on a petition for reinstatement to practice before the USPTO under 37 C.F.R. § 11.58; considers the petition, supporting affidavit, and record material to eligibility and results in Director-level determination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petition for Reinstatement under 37 C.F.R. § 11.58
rubrics_metrics.description: Petition for Reinstatement received and supported by an Affidavit pursuant to 37 C.F.R. § 11.58.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The petition should be accompanied by an affidavit under 37 C.F.R. § 11.58; the Office acknowledges receipt (here, received November 7, 2025) and the petitioner may be represented by counsel.

rubrics_metrics.name: Materials considered in evaluating reinstatement
rubrics_metrics.description: Decision is based on careful review of the Petition, the supporting affidavit, and all information in the record material to the petitioner’s eligibility for reinstatement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The reviewing authority examines the petition, the supporting affidavit, and all relevant record information bearing on eligibility; thoroughness and completeness of these submissions are therefore critical.

rubrics_metrics.name: Director-level determination and grant of reinstatement
rubrics_metrics.description: The Director of the Office of Enrollment and Discipline determines whether reinstatement to practice before the USPTO is appropriate and issues the final decision.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reinstatement is effected by Director action (signed decision) stating the outcome (e.g., 'Petition is hereby GRANTED'), with date and copy provided to counsel or the petitioner.
